title: Cheap Card Grading Service (2026)
verdict: A cheap card grading service is only a bargain if buyers trust the result, and AGS at $15 to $18 a card backs every grade with a public scan report.

Cheap grading has three traps: minimum orders, value caps and long waits. GMA needs 25 cards, CGC caps bulk cards at $500 in value, and Beckett's low price takes 45 business days or more. AGS avoids all three at $15 to $18.

why: One price covers everything. $18 buys the scan, the grade, eight subgrades, the report and the slab, for any card at any value. Orders of 30 or more TCG cards pay $15 a card on the standard bulk tier.
Nothing is locked in. No minimum order, no membership, no contract, and payment is taken when the cards are graded. A first order gets 20% off with code AGSNEW20.

Every slab comes with the evidence. The digital report shows eight subgrades, centering data, high-resolution images and a color-coded heightmap of the surface, red on major flaws and green on clean areas. You can download it or share it by link, and the scan stays on file against the cert number.

faq.q: Is a cheap card grading service any good?
faq.a: It can be. Price and quality are not the same axis in grading. Check what the fee includes, whether buyers accept the slab, and whether the grade comes with any evidence. AGS includes eight subgrades and a scan report at $15 to $18.

faq.q: How many cards count as a bulk order?
faq.a: 30 at AGS. CGC's bulk tier starts at 10 cards, GMA's economy tier at 25, and GMA drops its price again at 100.

faq.q: How much does AGS charge to grade a card?
faq.a: $18 per card at the standard rate, whatever the card is worth. Bulk orders of 30 or more TCG cards are $15 each at 20 business days, $20 at 10 or $30 at 5. Sports and non-TCG bulk is $3 more per tier.

faq.q: Do graders charge more for valuable cards?
faq.a: Several do. PSA and SGC price by declared value, and CGC caps each tier by card value and moves a card up if it is worth more. AGS, Beckett, TAG and ISA say they add no upcharge for value.

faq.q: Which card grader has the lowest listed price?
faq.a: As of November 18, 2026, GMA is lowest at $12 a card with a 25-card minimum, or $9 at 100 cards. CGC's bulk tier is $10 with a 10-card minimum on cards worth up to $500. Beckett's Base tier is $14.95, and ISA and AGS bulk are $15.
